facts.value: Discover new cultures and broaden your perspectives with a study abroad experience during your studies, as an internship, or job in research.
Experience the world with a study abroad or ERASMUS program! Improve your language skills, meet new cultures, and gain valuable international experience for your success in the job market.
You want to complete an internship abroad? We have compiled information on searching, organizing, and funding international internships as well as important application deadlines.
Teacher training students can find all information regarding internships abroad at the Academy for Educational Research and Teacher Education (ABL).
Here you can find helpful information for conducting the ERASMUS program and support for departmental cooperation.
Administrative and technical staff at Goethe University can find information on possible study abroad opportunities.
